reliability.rationale: The two-coefficient energy-memory equation reproduces 0.24728412 m2/s2 mean-week MAE versus 0.26272567 flexible and 0.26634491 persistence. Several unselected variants score slightly better after exposure and were correctly not promoted.

mechanism.rationale: Numerical implementation and measured-information contract checked. This computational review does not identify causality or independently validate the proposed physical/biological mechanism.

novelty.rationale: Executable accuracy and source consistency do not certify scientific novelty; independent literature/experimental assessment remains separate.

significance.rationale: Supported only as the explicit scoped numerical comparison or informative falsification; no population p-value or clinical/industrial acceptance threshold inferred.

reproducibility.rationale: Native preparation, all frozen development/confirmation predictions, standalone replay and independent metric arithmetic passed.

impact.rationale: No intervention, deployment cost/reliability study or independently measured downstream impact was executed.

checks: Hash-verified native reconstruction exactly reproduces identities, target values, grouping, predictor columns and source anchors.
All 10 frozen confirmation models and 9 development model families replayed; independent equal-group MAE matches saved arithmetic.
Every fold training-ID hash matches native development groups; whole-group and forward-time separation verified where applicable.
Source hash corruption and missing assets fail clearly; relocated native adapter and standalone frozen reference run without research imports.
Independent handwritten selected equation agrees with saved predictions to maximum absolute difference 8.88e-16.
Freeze file hashes intact and freeze timestamp precedes first confirmation receipt; no confirmation re-selection.
limitations: One mountain station and three reserved winter weeks; flags select a particular measurement-quality cohort.
Author-derived TKE and mean velocities share an instrument; fitted signs do not identify a full turbulence energy closure.
This is independent computational review, not independent experimental replication. Existing confirmation outcomes are exposed to future users.
